truth_evidence: Affected 2017.11.05 to 2022.09.24. The vulnerability is a distrusted root CA bundled in the certificate data, not a defect in Python code.

Fix commit 9e9e840 '2022.12.07' removes the TrustCor root certificates from certifi/cacert.pem; the only other change is the version string. https://github.com/certifi/python-certifi/commit/9e9e840925d7b8e76c76fdac1fab7e6e88c1c3b8
The fix commit also bumps __version__ in certifi/__init__.py. That is a module-level change to a .py file and must not be reported as vulnerable code.
No vulnerable function and no entry point exist; reachability is not a meaningful question for this advisory (every TLS verification using certifi.where() uses the bundle).
